title: Magic sparkle whoosh
author: Mixkit
license: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial and non-commercial use, no attribution required; https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree)
attribution_text: "Magic sparkle whoosh" - Mixkit (mixkit.co), Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (attribution not required)
description: 3.5s glittery sparkle that sweeps through like a light whoosh.
why_it_fits: Sparkle with built-in motion: ideal on the frosted bud just before it bursts (~5.5-6.5s) or as a twinkle riding the bloom wave.

title: Magic glitter or particles
author: Mixkit
license: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial and non-commercial use, no attribution required; https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree)

description: 6s soft, quiet glitter/particle twinkle bed (peaks around -14.5 dBFS).
why_it_fits: Gentle sustained shimmer for frost crystals at blue hour (0-6s) or pollen/particles drifting during the reveal; quiet enough to sit under music.

title: Sparkling fairy glow
author: Mixkit
license: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial and non-commercial use, no attribution required; https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree)
attribution_text: "Sparkling fairy glow" - Mixkit (mixkit.co), Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (attribution not required)
why_it_fits: Glowing, delicate sparkle for frost catching light or the bud glowing before the hit.

title: Crystal chime
author: Mixkit
license: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial and non-commercial use, no attribution required; https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree)
attribution_text: "Crystal chime" - Mixkit (mixkit.co), Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (attribution not required)
why_it_fits: Icy, crystalline single chime to punctuate frost details in the frozen meadow opening.

title: Shimmer
author: adh.dreaming
license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
attribution_text: "Shimmer" by adh.dreaming (freesound.org/s/632344/), CC0 1.0 - attribution not required
why_it_fits: Bright shimmering swell usable as the magical tail/halo right on or after the 6-7s bloom hit.

title: Mysterious Sparkle Flourish
author: SkySpeira
license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
attribution_text: "Mysterious Sparkle Flourish" by SkySpeira (freesound.org/s/844398/), CC0 1.0 - attribution not required
description: 3.9s subtle sparkle flourish, recorded quietly (peak about -19 dBFS; needs +gain).
why_it_fits: Delicate, mysterious flourish for the quiet blue-hour intro or a gentle final twinkle in the 25-30s fade.

title: Soft Cinematic Impact
author: Rizzard
license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
attribution_text: "Soft Cinematic Impact" by Rizzard (freesound.org/s/560156/), CC0 1.0 - attribution not required
description: 6s soft, deep cinematic impact with long decay.
why_it_fits: Exactly the brief: a deep, non-harsh boom to underpin the bud-burst HIT at 6-7s without sounding like an explosion.

title: Cinematic_Boom_Rhapsodize.wav
author: rhapsodize
license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
attribution_text: "Cinematic_Boom_Rhapsodize.wav" by rhapsodize (freesound.org/s/255111/), CC0 1.0 - attribution not required
description: 7.7s low, dramatic trailer-style boom with long low-end tail (very popular on Freesound).
why_it_fits: Big low-end weight for the main 6-7s HIT or the valley reveal; heavier than 560156, low-pass/lower gain to keep it soft.

title: Big cinematic impact

license: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial and non-commercial use, no attribution required; https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree)
attribution_text: "Big cinematic impact" - Mixkit (mixkit.co), Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (attribution not required)
description: 7.9s big cinematic impact with reverberant tail.
why_it_fits: Alternative main HIT layer with long cinematic tail; blend under music at reduced level for awe rather than aggression.

title: Cinematic impact waves
author: Mixkit
license: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial and non-commercial use, no attribution required; https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree)
attribution_text: "Cinematic impact waves" - Mixkit (mixkit.co), Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (attribution not required)
description: 7.8s impact followed by rolling low-frequency waves.
why_it_fits: The rolling waves after the hit read like an energy ripple spreading out: good for the moment the bloom wave launches across the land (~7s).

title: Movie Short Swell
author: jordivburgel
license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)

why_it_fits: Classic reverse swell that can be aligned to peak exactly on the 6-7s bud-burst HIT.

title: Reverse cinematic impact trailer

license: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial and non-commercial use, no attribution required; https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree)

why_it_fits: Ready-made reverse-swell-into-impact; trim the front so the swell starts ~2-3s and lands on the 6-7s HIT.

title: Cinematic suspense swell
author: Mixkit
license: Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial and non-commercial use, no attribution required; https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree)
attribution_text: "Cinematic suspense swell" - Mixkit (mixkit.co), Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (attribution not required)
why_it_fits: Longer tension build for the frozen-meadow anticipation (0-6s) or for the camera rise into the valley reveal (~14-16s).

title: first sunlight cinematic riser sound + abrupt stop and drone
author: Johnmode
license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
attribution_text: "first sunlight cinematic riser sound + abrupt stop and drone" by Johnmode (freesound.org/s/826672/), CC0 1.0 - attribution not required
description: 27.5s gentle riser that stops abruptly and leaves a drone; author describes it as the feeling of first morning light. Quiet (peak about -12 dBFS).
why_it_fits: Thematically perfect for blue hour turning to spring: use the rise for the opening, cut on the abrupt stop at the 6-7s bud burst, and keep the drone under the bloom.

title: 18'' Sabian china swell short reversed.wav

why_it_fits: Organic, acoustic reverse cymbal to suck into the HIT or into the valley reveal; less synthetic than trailer risers, suits a painterly nature film.

title: Creation Magic Blast

title: wind 8

title: Subterranean Deep Sub-Bass Rumble Drop

license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
